method: Interactive checks in Codex in-app browser via CUA, followed by independent comparison of downloaded MusicXML with score-summary.py.
build: app-web Release FastLink succeeded; updated browser scripts passed node --check
checks: Normal launch opens a real blank 16-measure piano score without developer controls.
File/Open and Ctrl+O import MXL and plain MusicXML.
Selected pitches increase by one semitone; rhythms, rests and staves are preserved.
Ctrl+Z restores original data; Ctrl+Y restores the edit.
Saved MSCZ reopens with edited content.
Exported MXL reimports with edited content.
Invalid ZIP input is rejected while the current project remains available.
Malformed MusicXML is rejected without abort; the current project still exports correctly.
Native canvas selection and keyboard editing work.
The 4 shortcut changes a selected quarter note to an eighth note.
Delete removes the original notes; N/5/C/D enters two new quarter notes.
The two new notes survive save/reopen.
Properties visibility and palette staccato changes are present in exported XML.
Parts and Page settings open; Landscape changes exported page dimensions.
Mixer and piano keyboard open from the real MuseScore components.
Playback cursor advances and Mixer signal meters show audio.
Status bar zoom and Page/Continuous mode controls work.
limitations: No new headless Chrome/Edge run is claimed for this shell revision.
Desktop floating docking, full score corpus, physical MIDI/audio latency, and practice modes remain outside this acceptance.
Recorded baseline heap/startup values predate the new shell and dialogs.
